## Network Test

The code was generated by ChatGPT

```{r}
# Load the igraph library
library(igraph)

# Define the edge list as a two-column data frame
edges <- data.frame(
  Source = c('Bill', 'Bill', 'Bill', 'Ruth', 'Ruth', 'Ruth', 'Ruth',
             'Jack', 'Jack', 'Mary', 'Mary', 'Nick', 'Nick', 'Nick',
             'Jane', 'Beth', 'Beth', 'Mack', 'Mack', 'Iris', 'Iris',
             'Iris', 'Iris', 'Adam', 'Adam'),
  Target = c('Ruth', 'Jack', 'Iris', 'Bill', 'Nick', 'Adam', 'Mary',
             'Bill', 'Adam', 'Ruth', 'Nick', 'Mary', 'Ruth', 'Adam',
             'Beth', 'Jane', 'Ruth', 'Iris', 'Mary', 'Mack', 'Mary',
             'Ruth', 'Nick', 'Nick', 'Ruth')
)

# Create a graph object from the data frame
network <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = FALSE)

# Plot the network
plot(network)
```

Modification to see if one-way relationships are better shown.

```{r}
# Load the igraph library
library(igraph)

# Define the edge list as a two-column data frame
edges <- data.frame(
  Source = c('Bill', 'Bill', 'Bill', 'Ruth', 'Ruth', 'Ruth', 'Ruth',
             'Jack', 'Jack', 'Mary', 'Mary', 'Nick', 'Nick', 'Nick',
             'Jane', 'Beth', 'Beth', 'Mack', 'Mack', 'Iris', 'Iris',
             'Iris', 'Iris', 'Adam', 'Adam'),
  Target = c('Ruth', 'Jack', 'Iris', 'Bill', 'Nick', 'Adam', 'Mary',
             'Bill', 'Adam', 'Ruth', 'Nick', 'Mary', 'Ruth', 'Adam',
             'Beth', 'Jane', 'Ruth', 'Iris', 'Mary', 'Mack', 'Mary',
             'Ruth', 'Nick', 'Nick', 'Ruth')
)

# Simplify the graph to merge multiple edges and remove loops
network <- simplify(network, remove.multiple = TRUE, remove.loops = TRUE)

# Set all edge widths to a bold value
edge.width <- rep(2, ecount(network))  # ecount(network) returns the number of edges

# Plot the network with all lines in bold
plot(network, edge.width = edge.width, edge.arrow.size = 0.5)
```

Try again

```{r}
# Load the igraph library
library(igraph)

# Define the edge list as a two-column data frame
edges <- data.frame(
  Source = c('Bill', 'Bill', 'Bill', 'Ruth', 'Ruth', 'Ruth', 'Ruth',
             'Jack', 'Jack', 'Mary', 'Mary', 'Nick', 'Nick', 'Nick',
             'Jane', 'Beth', 'Beth', 'Mack', 'Mack', 'Iris', 'Iris',
             'Iris', 'Iris', 'Adam', 'Adam'),
  Target = c('Ruth', 'Jack', 'Iris', 'Nick', 'Adam', 'Mary',
             'Adam', 'Mary', 'Nick', 'Ruth', 'Adam',
             'Beth', 'Iris', 'Mary', 'Mack', 'Mary',
             'Ruth', 'Nick', 'Ruth')
)

# Create a graph object from data frame
network <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = FALSE)

# Simplify the graph to merge multiple edges and remove loops
network <- simplify(network, remove.multiple = TRUE, remove.loops = TRUE)

# Set all edge widths to a bold value
edge.width <- rep(2, ecount(network))  # ecount(network) returns the number of edges

# Plot the network with all lines in bold
plot(network, edge.width = edge.width, edge.arrow.size = 0.5)
```

```{r}
# Install the packages if they are not installed yet
if (!requireNamespace("igraph", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("igraph")
if (!requireNamespace("ggraph", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("ggraph")
if (!requireNamespace("tidyverse", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("tidyverse")

# Load the packages
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

# Create a data frame with the relationships
relationships <- data.frame(
  from = c("Bill", "Bill", "Bill", "Ruth", "Ruth", "Ruth", "Ruth","Jack", "Jack", 
           "Mary", "Mary", "Nick", "Nick", "Nick", "Jane", "Beth", "Mack", "Mack",
           "Iris", "Iris", "Iris", "Iris", "Adam", "Beth", "Iris"),
  to   = c("Ruth", "Jack", "Iris", "Bill", "Nick", "Adam", "Mary", "Bill", "Adam", 
           "Ruth", "Nick", "Mary", "Ruth", "Adam", "Beth", "Jane", "Iris", "Mary", 
           "Mack", "Mary", "Ruth", "Nick", "Nick", "Ruth", "Nick")
)

# Find mutual relationships and create a new column for edge width
relationships %>%
  mutate(mutual = map2_chr(from, to, ~ ifelse(any(relationships$from == .y & relationships$to == .x), "yes", "no")),
         edge_width = if_else(mutual == "yes", 2, 1)) -> relationships_mutual

gt(relationships_mutual)


# Create an igraph object from the processed data frame
graph <- graph_from_data_frame(relationships_mutual, directed = TRUE)

# Plotting the network using ggraph
set.seed(111) # For reproducibility
ggraph(graph, layout = 'stress') + # reduce overlap: changed from kk
  geom_edge_link(aes(edge_width = edge_width), 
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(4, 'mm')), 
                 end_cap = circle(3, 'mm'),
                 color = "gray", 
                 show.legend = FALSE) + # suppress: added to GPT
  scale_edge_width(range = c(1, 2)) + # control size: added to GPT code
  geom_node_point(color = "gold", size = 5) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name), 
                 repel = TRUE, 
                 color = "darkred") +
  theme_graph()

ggsave("network2.png")


```
